name: QuickLook
description_en: Bring macOS “Quick Look” feature to Windows
readme_excerpt: QuickLook Instant File Previews, Just Press Space The most powerful Quick Look implementation for Windows The Problem Superpowers Get Started Extend Community 💡 The Problem Ever wished Windows had macOS's Quick Look? You know the drill: you want to peek at a file, so you double-click, wait for an app to launch, view the file, close the app... exhausting, right? macOS users? They just press Space .
